# Sincerity Cupping Clinic
> Insured wet cupping and hijama clinic for men and women in Streatham, South London.

## Key facts
- Name: Sincerity Cupping Clinic
- Address: 330 Streatham High Rd, London SW16 6HH, United Kingdom
- Phone: 07552 540000
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/447552540000
- Email: sinceritycupping@gmail.com
- Services: Wet cupping / Hijama
- Combined practitioner experience: 40 years
- Insurance: Fully insured
- Environment: clean and serene
- Service areas: Streatham, Streatham Hill, Streatham Common, Balham, Brixton, Tooting, Clapham, Norbury, Tulse Hill, West Norwood, Herne Hill, Dulwich, Crystal Palace, Mitcham, Colliers Wood


## Practitioners
- Sister Aisha Mejri — Lead Hijama Practitioner, 20+ years of experience. Sister Aisha Mejri is the lead practitioner at Sincerity Cupping Clinic with more than 20 years of hands-on experience in wet cupping and hijama. She leads female client sessions, manages clinical hygiene and is the first point of contact for new clients seeking guidance on suitability and aftercare.
- Brother Abu Layla — Senior Hijama Practitioner, 20+ years of experience. Brother Abu Layla is the senior practitioner for male clients at Sincerity Cupping Clinic. He leads male-only hijama appointments in a respectful, private environment with the same hygiene and aftercare standards used clinic-wide.

## Safety note
Cupping is a complementary therapy and is not a replacement for medical advice, diagnosis or treatment.
